patches.title: Transform Before Destination
patches.principle: After acquiring a task object that requires transformation, go directly to the transformation appliance before moving toward the destination.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task involves cleaning, heating, or cooling an object before placement.

patches.title: Start with Look
patches.principle: Begin each task by using the look action to observe all available furniture and objects in the room.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of any new task or after moving to a new room.

patches.title: Avoid Destination Detour Before Clean
patches.principle: Do not move to the final destination before cleaning the object. Go to the sink immediately after pickup.
patches.when_to_apply: When you are holding a dirty object that needs to be cleaned.
